Home / Certificates, Reports & Process

BOOM Drinkware / QUALITY & COMPLIANCE FILE

Certificates, Test Reports & Production Process

Every claim on this site should trace back to a document. These are the files we actually hold — management system certificates, two granted patents on detachable drinkware, test reports on finished cups, and material reports from the resin suppliers we buy from. Each entry names the holder and the number, so you can check it yourself.

HOW TO READ THIS PAGE

Files are grouped by holder. Hongrun New Material Technology is our affiliated production plant for moulded and blow-moulded drinkware; material reports are issued to the resin supplier, not to us. When you ask for a file against an order, we send only the one whose scope covers your model.

Management systemsPatentsFinished-product testsMaterial reports

01 / MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

Quality and environmental management

Audited management systems, not decorative badges. Both certificates are current, and the scope names blow-moulded drinkware specifically rather than a vague "manufacturing".

Held by Shenzhen Hongrun New Material Technology Co., Ltd. — our affiliated plant for moulded and blow-moulded drinkware, Pinghu, Longgang, Shenzhen.

The detachable stem is not a marketing story — it is a registered structure. Bowl and stem separate, so a damaged half is replaced instead of the whole glass, and the packed volume drops for freight.

Reports run on the finished cup

These two were submitted on finished drinkware — plastic champagne flutes and plastic wine glasses — which is the level a buyer usually needs when a market asks for food-contact evidence. A resin report alone does not answer that question.

What the resin supplier tested

Material reports belong to the resin maker. They tell you which grade was tested and against what rule — useful when you are writing a specification, but not a substitute for testing the cup you receive.

05 / PRODUCTION PROCESS

Nine steps from a drawing to a packed carton

This is the sequence an order actually follows. Which moulding step applies depends on the product: injection for rigid parts and stems, blow moulding for thin-wall cups, compression moulding for silicone. No temperature, cycle time or inspection threshold is published here — those are agreed per project.

01

Design and 3D review

Work from your artwork or a reference sample. A 3D file is issued and signed off before anything is cut.

02

Tooling and trial

CNC-cut mould, then trial shots. Dimensions and appearance are checked on the trial part, not on a promise.

03

Material and colour

Resin grade or silicone compound is fixed, and colour is matched to an approved chip or Pantone reference.

04

Moulding

Injection for rigid parts, blow moulding for thin-wall cups, compression moulding for silicone. Process parameters are locked per mould.

05

Trimming and deflashing

Gates and flash are removed and the rim and joint faces are dressed so parts assemble without force.

06

Decoration

Screen print, pad print, heat transfer, water transfer, laser or colour-change ink — chosen per design, not per convenience.

07

Post-cure

Silicone parts get a second high-temperature cure to stabilise the compound and drive off residual odour.

08

Inspection

Appearance, key dimensions, seal and assembly fit are checked against the approved sample before packing.

09

Packing and dispatch

Cartons are labelled to your specification and photographed before the container is sealed.

BUYER QUESTIONS

Before you quote one of these to your buyer

Can I see the full report, not just page one?

Yes. Tell us the model and the market you are selling into, and we send the PDF that actually covers it. What we will not do is send a report for a different grade and call it close enough.

Whose certificates are these?

The management system certificates and the patents are held by Hongrun New Material Technology, our affiliated production plant. The material reports are issued to the resin suppliers. Every file is labelled by holder on this page, so nothing is implied.

Does a patent give me the right to sell the design?

No. The patent protects the structure. Your right to sell a particular design comes from the agreement we sign. Tell us the market and we will say what applies before you commit to a quantity.

Will you test my order?

Third-party testing can be arranged against the standard your market requires. Scope, sample and cost are agreed before it starts, and the report is issued to you or to us as you prefer.

YOUR NEXT STEP

Ask for the file that matches your model

Send the model number, the market you are selling into and the document your buyer asked for. We will tell you which of these files applies, and which test still has to be run.

05 / 生产流程

从一张图到一箱货，九道工序

订单实际走的就是这条线。用哪种成型取决于产品：硬质件和杯柄注塑，薄壁杯吹塑，硅胶件模压。这里不写温度、周期和检验阈值 —— 那些按项目单独约定，写死在网页上就是骗人。

01

设计与 3D 确认

从你的图稿或参照样品开始。先出 3D，确认签字后才动刀。

02

开模与试模

CNC 加工模具，再试模。尺寸和外观在试模件上看，不听口头保证。

03

选料与配色

定树脂牌号或硅胶胶料，颜色对批准过的色卡或潘通号。

04

成型

硬质件注塑、薄壁杯吹塑、硅胶件模压。工艺参数按每副模具锁定。

05

修边去毛刺

去浇口、去飞边，杯口和配合面修整到位，装配不用使蛮力。

06

表面处理

丝印、移印、热转印、水转印、激光或变色油墨，按设计选，不按省事选。

07

二次烘烤

硅胶件做高温二次硫化，稳定材料性能，把残留气味烘掉。

08

全检

外观、关键尺寸、密封和装配配合，对照批准样品逐项过。

09

包装出货

按你的要求贴标装箱，封柜前拍照留档。

买家常问

把这些文件递给客户之前

能不能看完整报告，不只第一页？

可以。告诉我们型号和你卖去哪个市场，我们发真正覆盖它的那份 PDF。我们不会拿别的牌号的报告糊弄你说差不多。

这些证书是谁的？

体系证书和专利由宏润新材料持有 —— 那是我们做酒具的关联生产工厂。原料报告是出给树脂供应商的。这一页每份文件都标了持有人，不含糊。

有专利是不是我就能随便卖这个造型？

不是。专利保护的是结构。你能卖哪个造型，取决于我们签的协议。告诉我们目标市场，我们在你定数量之前把适用范围说清楚。

我的订单能送检吗？

可以按你目标市场要求的标准安排第三方检测。范围、样品和费用在开始前谈定，报告出给你或者出给我们，你定。

下一步

要哪份文件，报个型号

把型号、卖去哪个市场、买家要的是哪份文件发给我们。我们会告诉你手上哪份能用，哪一项还得重新做检测。
